frozen_at: 2026-09-06 before construction of the event analysis table

time.gwis_datetime_interpretation: UTC based on matching with heat detections converted from Colombia local time
time.primary_weather_validity_times: 24 hourly validity times strictly after GWIS initial time and not later than initial time plus 24 hours
time.antecedent_days: complete local calendar days before the local initial date

spatial_anchor.rule: centroid of all compatible national heat detections at the earliest timestamp inside the event geometry and GWIS interval
spatial_anchor.weather_sampling: bilinear interpolation on the regular ERA5 Land grid
spatial_anchor.elevation_sampling: nearest valid Copernicus DEM GLO 90 pixel centre
spatial_anchor.coverage_context: MapBiomas 2024 agricultural fraction in the municipality containing the anchor
spatial_anchor.prohibited_primary_anchor: centroid or areal average of the final GWIS polygon

outcomes.log_geometry_area_ha: natural logarithm of complete reconstructed GWIS geometry area in hectares
outcomes.log1p_detection_interval_hours: natural logarithm of GWIS final minus initial hours plus one

primary_exposures.vpd_mean_first_24h_kpa: mean vapour pressure deficit over the primary window
primary_exposures.wind_mean_first_24h_ms: mean 10 metre wind speed over the primary window

primary_covariates.anchor_elevation_m: Copernicus DEM GLO 90 digital surface elevation at the anchor
primary_covariates.anchor_municipality_agricultural_fractio: MapBiomas level 1 agricultural area divided by all classified area

derivations.vapour_pressure_kpa: 0.6108 multiplied by exp of 17.27 T divided by T plus 237.3
derivations.vpd_kpa: saturation vapour pressure at temperature minus vapour pressure at dewpoint
derivations.wind_speed_ms: square root of u10 squared plus v10 squared
derivations.precipitation_mm: hourly total precipitation in metres multiplied by 1000

exploratory_exposures: temperature mean first 24 hours replacing VPD
temperature maximum first 24 hours replacing VPD
precipitation during seven complete antecedent local days
maximum consecutive dry days during thirty complete antecedent local days

model.family: ordinary least squares on each transformed outcome
model.standardization: subtract median and divide by interquartile range

prohibited: stepwise or p value based selection
municipality fixed effects or multilevel model
simultaneous temperature and VPD in the primary model
FIRMS count or FRP as a covariate of GWIS area
deletion of influential observations without a demonstrated data error
